# NBCA (NABON Breast Cancer Audit)

IKNL/DICA variabelen dictionary for the NABON Breast Cancer Audit quality registry (2026).

| File | Format |
|------|--------|
| `IKNL-NBCA-2026-Variabelen-datadictionary-1-0-3-Raster.pdf` | PDF (2 pages, one continued table; columns `DATASET`, `VARIABELE`, `omschrijving variabele`, plus quality-registry columns) |

About 120 variables in three datasets (`patient`, `episode`, `tumor`). Legend rows with an empty `VARIABELE` cell are not extractable identifiers.

Origin: [DICA Borstkanker (NBCA)](https://dica.nl/registratie/borstkanker-nbca/), methodologically supported by IKNL. Originals are untrusted dictionary content.

Model id for ingest: `nbca`.
